description: Assign group names to contacts for organization and range-based selection. Groups are a fundamental organizational tool in PFC, allowing contacts to be categorized, selected, and manipulated based on group membership. Contacts can belong to multiple groups via different slots. By default, the group name is assigned to the 'Default' slot. Use 'slot' keyword to specify a particular slot. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered. IMPORTANT: The 'add' and 'remove' keywords apply to ALL contacts (or a previously active range), they cannot be combined with a 'range' keyword in the same command.

methods.description: Set contact group name in a given slot

parameters.group_name: Group name to assign (string or int)

methods.description: Get contact group name from a given slot

parameters.slot: Optional slot to remove from (if None, removes from all slots)

methods.description: Get all groups this contact belongs to
methods.returns: Dictionary mapping slot names to group names

methods.description: Test if contact is in specified group

parameters.slot: Optional slot to search (if None, searches all slots)

methods.returns: True if contact is in the group

notes: Python SDK requires iteration over contacts - cannot assign group to all contacts in one call
Command interface is more efficient for bulk group assignment
Use range specification in command interface to avoid Python iteration
Python provides richer query capabilities (in_group, groups dict)

command_vs_python.python: for c in it.contact.list():\n    if c.end1().type_id() == 'ball' and c.end2().type_id() == 'facet':\n        c.set_group('boundary')

notes: Contacts can belong to multiple groups using different slots
Default slot is 'Default' if not specified
Use 'add' keyword to add to next available slot for ALL contacts (cannot be combined with range)
Use 'remove' keyword to remove group from all slots for ALL contacts (cannot be combined with range)
More efficient than Python iteration for bulk group assignment
Groups are fundamental to PFC's organizational system
Group membership persists until explicitly changed or contact deleted
Related commands: contact apply-group, ball group, wall group, clump group, contact list
add assigns the name to the first empty slot of every contact and cannot be combined with range; remove strips the name from every slot where it appears.

keywords.description: Assign s to the next available slot.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Set group slot to slot . By default, slot Default is used.

examples.use_case: Identify lining contacts for boundary conditions
